subtopics.title: International Conventions and Diplomacy
subtopics.summary: The European Commission President has proposed exploring an 'Associate Member' relationship that could let Canada take part more closely in selected EU frameworks without full membership. Under the UN Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons, 128 countries reached a consensus on a working definition of lethal autonomous weapons systems. CITES regulates international trade in endangered wild species through three appendices, and the Montreal Protocol governs the phase-out of ozone-depleting substances and the Kigali Amendment mandates the phase-down of hydrofluorocarbons.
facts: EU proposal to explore an 'Associate Member' relationship, illustrated with Canada
'Associate Membership' is not an established membership category under the EU's foundational treaties
Treaty revision would require all 27 EU Member States to agree
Association Agreement under Article 217 of the TFEU is a more flexible alternative
Association Agreement needs unanimous approval in the Council and the consent of the European Parliament
CCW adopted in 1980 and entered into force in 1983
128 countries reached consensus on a working definition of Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems (LAWS)
CITES has 185 Parties; India became a Party in 1976
CITES species are listed in three appendices by conservation status and trade sensitivity
Montreal Protocol (1987) led to a 99% phase-out of controlled ozone-depleting substances; Kigali Amendment (2016) mandates phase-down of HFCs

subtopics.title: Governance, Standards and Schemes
subtopics.summary: The PM Vishwakarma scheme completed three years of implementation in September 2026 and supports artisans in 18 traditional trades. Registered Unrecognised Political Parties (RUPPs) are under scrutiny over political funding transparency, with the Election Commission of India registering parties under the Representation of the People Act, 1951. The Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026 make IST the single mandatory time reference for official purposes, and Karnataka has granted Tulu additional administrative language status.
facts: PM Vishwakarma scheme is fully funded by the Government of India and runs from FY 2023-24 to FY 2027-28
Covers 18 traditional trades in rural and urban areas
Only one member per family can apply; applicant must be over 18 years of age
Applicants who benefited from PMEGP or PM Swanidhi in the past 5 years are not eligible
RUPPs are registered with ECI but have not acquired status of a recognised State or National Party
Section 29A RPA 1951: registration of political parties; Section 29C: contribution reports
Supreme Court in ADR v. Union of India (2024) struck down the Electoral Bond Scheme
Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026 are notified under Section 52 of the Legal Metrology Act, 2009
IST is 5 hours 30 minutes ahead of UTC and is based on 82.5 degrees East longitude
Tulu was granted status of additional administrative language in Karnataka; Tulu is not in the Eighth Schedule

subtopics.title: Science, Environment and Culture
subtopics.summary: PRATUSH is a proposed Indian mission, while CosmoCube is a proposed lunar-orbiting mission led by scientists associated with the Royal Astronomical Society and University of Cambridge, both aimed at detecting the 21-cm signal from the early universe, while NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has been launched to study dark energy and exoplanets. Five young orangutans rescued in Odisha were moved to a zoo, and orangutans are native only to Borneo and Sumatra. World Rhino Day on 22 September highlighted the five rhino species, and the 2024 National Film Awards were announced.
facts: CosmoCube: proposed lunar-orbiting satellite to detect the 21-cm radio signal from the early universe
PRATUSH: Probing ReionizATion of the Universe using Signal from Hydrogen, by the Raman Research Institute with ISRO
Cosmic Dark Ages lie between about 380,000 years and about 200 million years after the Big Bang
Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope launched on a SpaceX Falcon Heavy and operates near Sun-Earth L2
Five young orangutans rescued in Balasore (Odisha) and moved to Nandankanan Zoological Park
Orangutans are not native to India; their natural range is the tropical forests of Borneo and Sumatra
World Rhino Day is observed on 22 September; the 2026 theme is 'Keep the Five Alive'
Greater One-Horned Rhino is the largest of the five rhino species and is concentrated in Kaziranga National Park, Assam
National Film Awards were established in 1954 and have been administered by the Directorate of Film Festivals since 1973
Best Feature Film award went to Article 370 (Hindi)
